tasks.short: Pay winning bets and collect losing bets

steps.what: Verify the actual game outcome under the applicable table rules
Identify each player's winning or losing stake
Determine winnings using the existing payout schedule
Count and arrange chips for the actual payouts and collections
Check exact chip amounts, player positions and settlement validity
Hand winning chips to players or collect the checked losing stakes

tasks.design: Retain direct outcome verification, stake identification, chip handling and checked settlement at the table. The existing payout schedule already gives the calculation rule; adding a calculator without a counted source of live stakes and outcomes would introduce new entry rather than remove an established step.
tasks.previous_blocker: A payout rule is simple, but the actual outcome, stake position and physical chips still need verification.
tasks.enabler_now: No new component removes work in the conventional physical-table branch described here.
tasks.still_hard: Misplaced chips and disputed outcomes require immediate dealer attention.
tasks.human_edge: The dealer maintains a visible, trusted settlement sequence and stops disputed transactions.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in settlement time or financial responsibility.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of gambling services workers
reach.learn: Traceable chip counting and rule interpretation

evidence.claim: Electronic table settlement exists according to model knowledge, but its existence does not establish a usable live input feed or a labour saving at this physical table.

assumptions: Boundary is a conventional physical table using visible stakes and an existing payout schedule. It does not assume new card readers, chip sensors or replacement of the game by an electronic table.

The dealer establishes actual outcomes and stakes in s1-s2. No structured outcome/stake feed is assumed; re-keying them into new software would be additional work that must be measured before proposing a calculator.

Before assigning zero, physical counting, arithmetic lookup, verification and actual transfer are separated. Actual cash-wager recording is explicitly modelled in 4456. No per-hand payout report or register nobody uses is invented.
The s5 check binds the exact prepared chip values and player positions before s6; a changed stake or outcome requires rechecking. All action time remains, and no new tool means zero upkeep.
unknowns: Table technology and existing settlement aids
Any actual duplicate settlement record beyond the wager ledger
research_questions: Is there an existing reliable digital outcome/stake feed that avoids new input capture?

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact prepared chip values, winning recipients or losing stake positions and verified outcome for this settlement; any change voids permission

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All one hundred hours remain after separating the actual financial transfer and calculation lookup. No existing input feed or changed record step supports a net reduction in this physical-table branch.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Exchange cash for playing chips or coins

steps.what: Receive the player's paper currency visibly at the table
Count and verify the received currency
Count the equivalent playing chips or coin denominations
Check equivalent value and the receiving player's position
Give the exact checked chips or coins to the player
Place verified cash into the table drop according to procedure

tasks.design: Keep visible receipt, currency verification, equivalent-chip counting and physical exchange under the current table procedure. A records app does not remove these physical actions, and no new per-exchange receipt or register is presumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task is physical custody and value verification rather than repeated document processing.
tasks.enabler_now: No new component changes this actual exchange sequence.
tasks.still_hard: Incorrect notes, denominations or recipient positions must be resolved before money moves.
tasks.human_edge: The dealer keeps the exchange visible and checks exactly what the player receives.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in exchange labour or custody responsibility.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of gambling services workers

evidence.claim: A physical cash-for-chip exchange still requires receipt, verification and handling; this branch and its shares are model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is physical table exchange. Equivalent-value chip counting uses current denominations; no foreign-exchange conversion or cashier service is invented.
The dealer produces verified value and the prepared chip stack directly in s2-s3. There is no assumed clean cash feed, automatic counter or cash-handling robot.

Checked actual record writes, reports and sends before zero: this branch uses visible cash and chips plus physical drop, with no dealer-kept individual exchange form. Cash-wager entry is a distinct action explicitly present in 4456, not hidden here. If local exchange recording exists, split and measure that real action before applying this branch.
The final value and recipient check in s4 covers the s5 chip transfer; changes require a new check. No new tool is deployed and upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether this table actually requires a separate exchange record
research_questions: Does the local dealer perform an actual repeated record entry for each exchange?

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact verified cash value, prepared chip or coin denominations and receiving player position; changes void permission

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All one hundred physical exchange hours remain. The actual transfer is separate and unchanged; no unperformed receipt or digital-register baseline supplies a saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Receive, verify and record cash wagers

steps.what: Receive the patron's cash wager and stated bet
Verify cash value, permitted stake and the patron's intended selection
First enter the cash wager in the table wager ledger {OTHER}
Check exact cash amount, selection, round and player attribution
Confirm acceptance of the exact checked wager in the ledger

tasks.design: Configure the existing wager ledger {OTHER} to default only current table, game and round context. Keep actual cash receipt, verification, first entry of stake and selection, final meaning checks and consequential wager acceptance with the dealer.
tasks.previous_blocker: First wager capture was mixed with repeatedly entering known table context.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field defaults can remove repeated context entry without reading money or choosing a bet.
tasks.still_hard: The stated selection, actual cash and accepted bet must agree before the round proceeds.
tasks.human_edge: The dealer resolves ambiguity with the patron before accepting the wager.
tasks.altitude: A small repeated-context reduction; cash handling and acceptance responsibility stay unchanged.

reach.task: Verify a recorded wager against the patron's instruction

evidence.claim: Native wager-form context can reduce repeated entry while retaining all actual stake capture; this conditional design and allocation are model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary includes the task's real first wager record, separately from money handling. This branch assumes an existing electronic table wager ledger; paper recording stays manual unless a separately priced change is justified.

The dealer supplies actual amount, denomination, player position and wager selection in fully retained receipt/verification and near-fully retained s3. Table/game/round IDs come from the currently selected ledger context. Missing or changed context is corrected manually in retained entry and check time; no camera or cash-reader feed is assumed.

Only 1.2 of twenty-four entry hours is repeated context. The remaining 22.8 captures the real wager and corrects errors. All five final check hours remain. Native defaults precede code; no first-capture or physical-time reduction is claimed.

The one-hour s5 action is legally or operationally consequential wager acceptance under local procedure, fully retained with no saving. It is distinct from ordinary author saving, which remains inside entry time without a gate or benefit; if local procedure has only an ordinary save, fold it into entry and remove this acceptance gate.
unknowns: Whether ledger acceptance is a distinct consequential action
research_questions: Which current context fields are actually retyped on each cash wager?

already_counted.description: Check exact wager meaning and attribution

incremental.description: Check table/game context defaults after configuration changes

approvals.approved_version: s4 final exact cash value, selection, table, round and player position for this wager acceptance; any edit voids permission

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross is 1.2 repeated-context hours less 0.2 upkeep = 1. Cautious case: paper records or current defaults leave no repeated electronic context to remove; retain all twenty-four entry hours and add no configuration, giving zero. Cash handling and wager acceptance remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise staff and protect table-game security

steps.what: Monitor gambling tables, staff actions and game security
Direct and coach staff on secure table procedures
Investigate observed irregularities and decide immediate security action
Write the actual security incident report in the incident system {OTHER}
Check the report's meaning, facts and named security recipient
Send the checked incident report to the named internal security queue

tasks.design: Retain live staff supervision and security judgement. In the branch where actual irregularities already produce a security report, configure table/time context in the incident system {OTHER}, then route only the final checked report to the approved internal queue.
tasks.previous_blocker: A genuine irregularity report combines repeated table context with sensitive factual allegations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native form context and explicit routing can address repetition without identifying suspects or judging intent.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous conduct and conflicting accounts require direct investigation.
tasks.human_edge: The supervising dealer knows the table procedure and can distinguish an error from a concern needing escalation.
tasks.altitude: A modest incident-report reduction where that record already exists; no change to monitoring or staff authority.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of gambling services workers

evidence.claim: Native incident context and internal routing are plausible components; no measured dealer-security reporting result is supplied. The design and shares are model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual irregularity reporting used by the security supervisor, not a routine new end-of-shift log for uneventful monitoring. The allocation is conditional on the dealer already performing that work.

The dealer establishes actual incident, location, time, observed acts and action taken in retained s1-s3 and first records the narrative in s4. Current table context supplies only table ID and visible time; it does not supply allegations or inferred intent. Missing context is manually corrected within retained writing time.

Two of ten report-entry hours are repeating table/time context and standard report structure; eight remain for first factual narrative, uncertainty and correction. All four final meaning-check hours remain. Native configuration precedes custom code.

The one-hour routing action is an actual send to another person's queue, not an author save. Ordinary saving remains within entry time without a gate or saving. The s5 approval binds exact final narrative, attachments and recipient; changed facts require a new check.
unknowns: Whether this dealer actually writes security incident reports
research_questions: Which report fields are repeated context rather than first factual capture?

already_counted.description: Check final factual meaning and security destination

incremental.description: Maintain incident defaults and security routing

approvals.approved_version: s5 final exact incident narrative, table and time, attachments, action description and named internal security queue; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross is two repeat-context hours plus one actual routing hour, less 0.5 upkeep = 2.5. Cautious case: an unusual event needs a wholly bespoke report with all ten entry hours retained; the genuine internal send still removes one, less 0.5 upkeep = 0.5. Live supervision and investigation are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Physical money handling, game security and patron clarification stay with the dealer. Small benefits depend on actual wager and incident forms, not on assumed sensor feeds or per-hand reports.
reach: Work with table supervisors on clear financial and security checks
role.ambitious_version: A dealer with less repeated context entry in real records while maintaining visible, checked transactions and direct game supervision.
